constraints: This target uses the legacy com.apple.dnsSettings.managed configuration-profile payload.
Legacy DNSSettings semantics are distinct from the declarative DNS model.
Do not alias this target to the declarative DNS schema.
DNSProtocol is required. ServerURL is required when DNSProtocol is HTTPS; ServerName is required when DNSProtocol is TLS. ServerAddresses may be supplied as the resolver address list.
This payload is deprecated on current Apple OS releases and must be treated as a legacy compatibility target.

syntax.payloadKeys: DNSSettings, OnDemandRules?, ProhibitDisablement?, PayloadType, PayloadVersion, PayloadIdentifier, PayloadUUID
syntax.dnsSettingsKeys: DNSProtocol, ServerURL and/or ServerAddresses, AllowFailover?, PayloadCertificateUUID?, SupplementalMatchDomains?
